dimension_a_pseudo.title: Step 9 pseudo merges two distinct nodes (Filter + Return) into one step
dimension_a_pseudo.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-52.pseudo:42 — Step 9 reads 'Filter that list for the one whose name equals the prepared channelName, then build existing-channel return'. The live .md has two separate nodes: 'Filter - Existing User Channel' (filter v2.2) and 'Return Channel Info - Existing' (code v2), each with their own connection topology.
dimension_a_pseudo.recommended_action: Split pseudo Step 9 into Step 9 (Filter — find channel whose name equals channelName, go to Step 10) and Step 10 (Build existing-channel return: {success:true, channelId, channelName, channelUrl, isNew:false}, go to Step 12); renumber Step 10→11 Error and Step 11→12 End accordingly. Alternatively accept the merge as intentional prose-level compression if the project treats filter+transform as a single logical step — but document the convention.

dimension_a_pseudo.title: Entry guard pseudo spec says 'name is a non-empty string' but live guard only checks typeof, not empty
dimension_a_pseudo.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-52.pseudo:31 — Step 2 states 'name is a non-empty string'. Live Validate Inputs jsCode (docs/pseudocode/WF-52.md:101) checks only `typeof input.name !== 'string'`, without the `|| input.name.trim() === ''` trim-guard that phoneNumber has.
dimension_a_pseudo.recommended_action: Either (a) tighten the jsCode guard to also reject empty-string name (matching the pseudo spec), or (b) update the pseudo to say 'name is a string (may be empty)' if empty name is acceptable for this field. Given name is used for channel-creation context, non-empty is the safer choice.

dimension_b_drift.title: 'Prepare Channel Name' node jsCode still contains legacy phone_number and userName fallbacks — contradicts both the pseudo and the entry guard contract
dimension_b_drift.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-52.md:69 — jsCode: `const phoneNumber = input.phone_number || input.phoneNumber || '';` and `userName: input.name || input.userName || ''`. The pseudo Step 3 (docs/pseudocode/WF-52.pseudo:32) states only 'channelName = "consult-" + phoneNumber. Carry name, phoneNumber, userId forward' with no fallback. The Inputs block (pseudo line 17) explicitly states 'Legacy aliases removed: phone_number and userName are no longer accepted.' The node was not updated as part of this sprint.
dimension_b_drift.recommended_action: Update 'Prepare Channel Name' jsCode in live n8n: (1) remove `input.phone_number || ` prefix from phoneNumber resolution (guard already ensures input.phoneNumber exists); (2) remove `|| input.userName` fallback from the userName key; (3) rename the emitted key from `userName` to `name` to match canonical contract — the node currently emits `userName:` in its output object, but callers and the pseudo expect `name`. Verify no downstream node in WF-52 reads `$json.userName` after this fix (only 'Create Slack Channel' is next; it reads channelName, not userName/name, so the rename is safe).

dimension_b_drift.title: 'Prepare Channel Name' node emits output key 'userName' but pseudo carries field as 'name'
dimension_b_drift.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-52.md:69 — emitted object has key `userName: input.name || input.userName || ''`. docs/pseudocode/WF-52.pseudo:32 — Step 3 says 'Carry name, phoneNumber, userId forward'. No downstream node within WF-52 consumes this key, so no runtime break, but the pseudo↔.md field-name mismatch is a documentation contract violation.
dimension_b_drift.recommended_action: Covered by the Blocker finding above — rename emitted key to 'name' when fixing the fallback removal.
